# Third-party code

These single-file libraries by Sean Barrett are used for image decoding,
resizing, PNG and JPEG writing, and font rendering. They are in the public
domain (or MIT, at your choice). See the license text at the end of each file.

- stb_image.h
- stb_image_write.h
- stb_image_resize2.h
- stb_truetype.h

Source: https://github.com/nothings/stb
